name: Emily Margaret Schriefer (Poehlman, McKeldin)
notable_stories: Her first husband was shot down on D-Day
She passed away when her daughter Barbara was only two and a half years old
Her death triggered the family's move to the Quinn household

First husband Jack Poleman, naval aviator shot down on D-Day. His insurance policy named Emily beneficiary. Emily redirected beneficiaries to brothers Kenneth and George Schriefer Jr. before marrying Buckey, then never updated. After Emily's 1950 death, the brothers took the money — source of Buckey's lifelong falling-out with his brothers-in-law (memoir p. 13-14).
Photographed at University of Virginia, Charlottesville, 30 May 1943
Her uncle the magician (unidentified) is a collateral relative
Had an uncle who was a magician (per memoir p. 15 photo caption) — collateral relative, unidentified

Insurance-policy feud: Jack Poleman's policy named Emily beneficiary; she redirected to brothers Kenneth and George Jr. before marrying Buckey, then never updated. After her 1950 death the brothers took the money — source of Buckey's lifelong feud with brothers-in-law (memoir p. 13-14)
Barbara describes her as 'quite the equestrian', and family photos show her at Ocean City.
The 'uncle the magician' Emily helped in an old photo is probably her uncle John Joseph Quinn, whom Barbara remembers doing magic tricks for the children.
milestones: Married Charles E. Buckey McKeldin II

education: Went to Seton High School. This is why Barbara chose Mercy High instead.

Emily Schriefer and Peggy Quinn were 1ST COUSINS: John Joseph Quinn (Peggy's father) was Ethel Quinn Schriefer's (Emily's mother) youngest brother.

CORRECTION: born 20 Feb 1921 in Baltimore and died 21 Oct 1950, in her 30th year, per her death notice (Baltimore Sun, 23 Oct 1950) and Find a Grave; she was 9 in the 1930 census and 19 in 1940. The earlier birth "abt 1914" came from Barbara remembering her as 36, and 24 Oct was not her death date.
The censuses, her parents' death notices and Find a Grave spell the family name Schriefer.
The Quinn Family Tree on Ancestry gives her birth as 4 Feb 1921 and her death as Oct 1951; her death notice (Oct 1950) and Find a Grave (20 Feb 1921) are followed here.
She married Charles E. McKeldin on 2 Nov 1945 in Baltimore, aged 24, a widow, living at 334 E. 21st Street (marriage licence 5549). The church register gives her baptism as 20 Feb 1921 at St. John's.
